# Project Context

- Repository: `jamesmontemagno/auto-github-changelog-poster`
- Source of truth for code: GitHub repository
- Source of truth for planning: Azure DevOps
- Azure DevOps organization: `devdiv-advocacy`
- Default Azure DevOps project for this repo: `Community Team Projects`

## Work Item Type Guidance

- `Task`: implementation work, refactors, hardening, operational improvements, and technical debt
- `Bug`: broken behavior, regressions, incidents, or user-visible failures
- `User Story` or `Product Backlog Item`: backlog planning items when explicitly requested
- If the user only says "issue" or "ticket", ask which type they want instead of silently choosing one

## Typical Description Shape

Use short sections when drafting a work item:

- Goal
- Scope
- Constraints or guardrails
- Expected outcome

## Reporting Back

After creating work items, summarize:

- work item IDs
- titles
- project
- type used
- any unresolved ambiguity such as missing parent link, assignee, or iteration
